description: Enable and enforce TLS 1.3 for all PostgreSQL database connections across a fleet of 200 microservices. Current state: plaintext connections on port 5432. Target state: all connections forced to TLS with mutual certificate validation. Each service must be updated with CA certificate, client cert, and client key. Rollout plan must be service-by-service with monitoring of failed connections. Risk factors: expired or misconfigured certificates causing full service outages, certificate rotation not automated, services with hardcoded connection strings, incompatible driver versions, and increased CPU overhead on database server from TLS handshake. Verify with pg_stat_ssl that all connections use TLS. Tools available: cert-manager, Vault PKI, Kubernetes secrets, Spire for SPIFFE, pgaudit, pg_stat_ssl.
